items.title: You are what you prompt! (Search IRL Dublin 2026)
items.summary: Prompt tracking shows which brands AI assistants mention and cite. It does not show what customers already know, believe or prefer, or what they do after reading the answer.This talk covers ten research-informed ideas about how consumers use AI assistants and respond to their recommendations. It then sets out customer and AI diagnostics you can run for your own brand.The answer isn’t the whole story.Presented at Search IRL, Dublin, November 2026.
